text:
maya: short proposal — unify client-facing error signals so console + SDKs show the same badge. sketch below.

devon: ok, what surface are you thinking?

maya: emit a tiny numeric header `x-rw-sc` (surface-code) + keep http status. sc maps to badges and retry policy. also add optional `x-rw-note` for edge notes.

lex: numeric is nice for parsers. what's the mapping?

maya: draft: 1=healthy (no badge), 11=rate-limited, 21=slow/capacity, 31=downstream-fail, 99=other-failure. servers set Retry-After when appropriate.

sofia: console buckets we'll call: HEALTHY | RATE-LIMITED | SLOW | UNAVAILABLE. need 1-line copy per bucket <=80 chars.

rui: ops asks: make sure we tag traces with `err_bucket` (sc -> bucket) at ingress so Grafana panels can split without reprocessing logs. also record raw header for sampling.

devon: SDKs should respect sc and `x-rw-note=idempotency=false` to avoid blind retries. ship SDK support behind a feature flag.

maya: rollout plan: internal canary (2 days) -> 14-day canary -> GA. include a quick S3 reclass job to backfill last 45 days so dashboards don't jump.

ops-bot: preview deploy for branch `errtax/sc-header-v2` created: https://deploys.internal/preview/3001

lex: infra: add alerting split for spikes in sc=21 vs sc=11 so we can distinguish capacity vs quota.

sofia: i'll draft copy and 2 A/B variants.

maya: will add RFC with exact numbers, examples and SDK pseudocode, then ping for final sign-off.
